Inclusion Criteria:
  -  reactive arthritis diagnosed in one of the two rheumatology departments from Centre Hospitalier Lyon Sud  [OR] or Besançon
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  presence of other known causes of arthritis, such as other defined spondyloarthritides, septic arthritis, [OR]  Lyme disease, microcrystalline arthritis  [OR] or rheumatoid arthritis
